integrity: The single degree-six non-right-stable null polynomial was already supplied by Havlovec (2026) and is expressly credited. The new contribution is the full module presentation, sharp minimum degree, polynomial-function module structure and constant right-stabilizer. Exact finite rank verification uses the attached standalone checker; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the specified 128-element matrix ring over the binary field; it does not determine the entire polynomial right idealizer or analogous modules for other rings.
title: A complete null-polynomial module and right-stabilizer for a 128-element matrix ring
